description: Cryptstalker Girdle Level 60 Huntsman Leopold at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Cryptstalker Girdle if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Girdle, 8 Wartorn Chain Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar and 3 Nexus Crystals. Requirements: - Desecrated Girdle - Wartorn Chain Scrap x 8 - Arcanite Bar - Nexus Crystal x 3
name: Cryptstalker Girdle
